description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) of different models as a function of the co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)," ranges from 60% to 80%. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black line with circle markers), MEND (brown line with diamond markers), FT (blue line with triangle markers), MEMIT (purple line with pentagon markers), IKE (red line with square markers), and ROME (green line with cross markers). The Base model starts at approximately 65% accuracy at the lowest co-occurrence number and ends around 70% at the highest co-occurrence number. The MEND model begins at around 70% and ends near 80%. The FT model starts at about 65% and ends close to 75%. The MEMIT model begins at approximately 68% and ends around 78%. The IKE model starts at about 67% and ends near 77%. The ROME model begins at around 70% and ends close to 80%.
